component.name: Grainhouse
component.summary: Film looks, AI effects and editing tools for your photos

description.p: A photo editor with film looks, AI effects and proper editing tools, all in one window. Drop in a RAW file or a JPEG, pick a film stock, push the light around, add an effect, and export.

ul.li: White balance, exposure, shadows, highlights, tone curve, colour mixer, colour grading and Auto
Crop, straighten, lens corrections, noise reduction, sharpening and local adjustments with AI masks
153 film stocks, 24 creative looks, your own .cube LUTs and camera looks
30 effects, many using AI to find the people in your photo
Diffusion filters, halation, grain, light leaks and film frames
Real-ESRGAN upscaling and AI sharpening on export

description.p: Everything runs on your own computer.
